infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: HMore uses the camera to photograph maintenance issues and property documents.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: HMore needs photo library access to attach images to repairs and uploads.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: HMore uses the microphone to dictate support notes on this device.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: HMore transcribes dictated support notes on this device.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: HMore uses Face ID to unlock a session that is already signed in on this device. Face data stays on the device and is not sent to servers.
